description: As nhflow_1d_si_nh_vrans_wave_submerged with a porous block through the free surface (x 7-7.4 m, to 0.2 m above the still water level) and the SSP-RK2 predictor (A 510 12): the storage n_s of the continuity with the surface inside the block (reflection, transmission; on the finer grid of the validation run the wave heights in front, inside and behind are within 4 % of the explicit RK2).
